description: An STM32 Nucleo-64 board with an STM32F401RE chip, an ST-LINK debugger, Arduino headers and ST Morpho headers, a green LED and a blue user button.
summary: The board runs the user's sketch in the iynk interpreter. Pins, PWM, I2C, serial and timing follow the nucleo-f401re board profile. It is not the STM32F401RE chip.
led: LD2, the green LED on D13 (PA5): HIGH turns it on.
button: B1 USER, the blue button on PC13: reads LOW when pressed.

models.1: Arduino-C++ subset run by the interpreter with the Nucleo pin map.
models.2: Digital I/O on D0 to D15 and A0 to A5, PWM on D3, D5, D6, D9, D10 and D11, interrupts on every pin.
models.3: 10-bit analog reads, or 12-bit after analogReadResolution(12), I2C master on D14 and D15, serial output, LD2 on D13 and the B1 USER button on PC13.

not.1: The ST-LINK debugger and the USB virtual serial port.
not.2: The clock tree and every peripheral other than digital I/O, ADC, PWM, I2C and serial.
not.3: The Morpho pins that have no Arduino name: they are listed but the interpreter does not drive them.

gap: undefined No electrical ratings are listed yet, so no pin-overload check exists for this board.
